## listLists

List Lists. `GET /lists`

List all lists for the tenant with pagination.

Returns paginated list of all static, dynamic, and newsletter lists. Each list includes its computed contact count (for email subscriptions).

```php
$result = $sendseven->lists()->listLists();
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$page` | `?int` | no | Page number (1-indexed) |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Items per page |

Returns `Page<ListResponse>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Lists/list_lists_api_v1_lists_get)

## create

Create List. `POST /lists`

Create a new list (static, dynamic, or newsletter).

- Static lists: Contacts are manually added/removed - Dynamic lists: Contacts are matched via segment conditions - Newsletter lists: Contacts subscribe via widgets/deep links

```php
$result = $sendseven->lists()->create(name: 'name', listType: 'list_type');
```

- Scopes: `lists:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$name` | `string` | yes | List name |
| `$listType` | `ListType\|string` | yes | Type of list: static, dynamic, or newsletter |
| `$description` | `?string` | no | List description |
| `$segmentConditions` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Segment conditions for dynamic lists |
| `$slug` | `?string` | no | URL-safe slug for newsletter lists (auto-generated if not provided) |
| `$newsletterConfig` | `?string` | no | JSON string for newsletter configuration. Keys: opt_in_keywords, opt_out_keywords, welcome_message, goodbye_message, confirmation_message, auto_subscribe_via_deeplink, plus the button lists welcome_buttons / goodbye_buttons — each up to 3 objects of {"type": "unsubscribe"\|"unsubscribe_all"\|"subscribe"\|"url", "caption": "max 20 chars", "url": "https://… (url type only)"}. Buttons render natively on WhatsApp / Telegram / Messenger / Instagram and degrade to a keyword text hint elsewhere. Omitting goodbye_buttons entirely means a default "Re-subscribe" button is added; send [] for none. |
| `$showInPreferenceCenter` | `?bool` | no | Whether this newsletter list is offered in the hosted email preference center (the 'Manage preferences' link in emails). Defaults to false — opt in explicitly to expose a list. Lists created before this field existed remain visible. |
| `$isDefault` | `?bool` | no | Whether this is the default list for global 'start'/'stop' keywords. Only one list per tenant can be default. |
| `$optInAction` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Per-channel opt-in action (send a MESSAGE or start a FLOW — never both). {default, per_channel}; per_channel keys are SubscriptionChannelType values. Omit to keep the legacy welcome message from newsletter_config. Flow actions must reference a published, same-tenant flow. |
| `$optOutAction` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Per-channel opt-out action (MESSAGE or FLOW). Same shape as opt_in_action. Omit to keep the legacy goodbye message. |
| `$hubSpotOptinFieldConfig` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Per-channel HubSpot contact-property mapping applied on opt-in / opt-out ({default, per_channel} of {property_name, opt_in_value, opt_out_value}). Persisted here; the HubSpot write is performed off the contact.subscribed/unsubscribed event by the integrations layer. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ListResponse`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Lists/create_list_api_v1_lists_post)

## evaluateConditionsCount

Evaluate Conditions Count. `POST /lists/evaluate-count`

Count contacts matching inline segment conditions.

Accepts segment conditions directly (no saved list required) and returns the count of matching contacts without loading them into memory.

```php

## getSubscriptionStats

Get Lists Subscription Stats. `GET /lists/subscription-stats`

Batch opt-in / opt-out / net-change counts for every list in the window.

Returns a row for EVERY list the tenant has (zeros for lists with no subscription activity) so the frontend can map results by list_id.

```

- Scopes: `lists:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$windowDays` | `?int` | no | Rolling window size in days |

Returns `ListSubscriptionStats`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Lists/get_lists_subscription_stats_api_v1_lists_subscription_stats_get)

## addContactTo

Add Contact To List. `POST /lists/{list_id}/members`

Add a contact to a list (static or newsletter).

- Static lists: channel_type should be None (uses email by default) - Newsletter lists: channel_type is required (email, telegram, messenger, instagram, etc.); channel_id is additionally required for the scoped channels telegram / messenger / instagram.

```php
$result = $sendseven->lists()->addContactTo(listId: 'list_id', contactId: 'contact_id');
```

- Scopes: `lists:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$listId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes | ID of the contact to add |
| `$channelType` | `?string` | no | Required for newsletter subscriptions (email, telegram, messenger, instagram, ...). DEPRECATED fallback: if omitted for a newsletter list it defaults to email, but this fallback will be removed in a future release — always pass channel_type. |
| `$channelId` | `?string` | no | Channel ID (which bot/page). Required only for scoped newsletter channels: telegram, messenger, instagram. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `AddMember`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Lists/add_contact_to_list_api_v1_lists__list_id__members_post)

## removeContactFrom

Remove Contact From List. `DELETE /lists/{list_id}/members/{contact_id}`

Remove a contact from a list.

- Static lists: Removes the contact completely - Newsletter lists: Removes the subscription for a specific channel; channel_type is required. (For backwards compatibility a missing channel_type still falls back to email, but this is DEPRECATED and will be removed in a future release.) - Dynamic lists: Cannot remove (membership determined by conditions)

```php
$sendseven->lists()->removeContactFrom(listId: 'list_id', contactId: 'contact_id');
```

- Scopes: `lists:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$listId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$channelType` | `?string` | no | Required for newsletter unsubscriptions (email, telegram, messenger, instagram, ...). DEPRECATED fallback: if omitted for a newsletter list it defaults to email, but this fallback will be removed in a future release — always pass channel_type. |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Lists/remove_contact_from_list_api_v1_lists__list_id__members__contact_id__delete)

## getSubscriptionActivity

Get List Subscription Activity. `GET /lists/{list_id}/subscription-activity`

Per-list opt-in / opt-out event drill-down (paginated, newest first).

- direction filters to opt-in events (in), opt-out events (out), or both (all), all within the window. - last_message_in_list is populated only for unsubscribed events (the last outbound campaign message this contact received on this channel that belongs to the list), with attribution of exact / ambiguous / none. It is null for subscribed events.

```php
$result = $sendseven->lists()->getSubscriptionActivity(listId: 'list_id');
```

- Scopes: `lists:read`, `contacts:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$listId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$windowDays` | `?int` | no | Rolling window size in days |
| `$direction` | `?string` | no | all \| in \| out |
| `$page` | `?int` | no | Page number (1-indexed) |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Items per page |

Returns `Page<SubscriptionActivityItem>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Lists/get_list_subscription_activity_api_v1_lists__list_id__subscription_activity_get)
